analytical_question: What kind of innovation is this technology and application, and how could it create, destroy, displace, or reshape value in this organization and its business model?
general_et_finding: LLM text assistance has demonstrated practical use in consulting-like tasks (E2), supporting innovation beyond laboratory invention. This is a general technology finding, not evidence that any proposed firm deployment is implemented or commercially viable. No claim of a new technical invention, universal reliability or market diffusion rate is warranted.
application_finding: Prospective incremental process innovation: drafting changes, but consultant judgment, partner accountability and client delivery remain. It becomes realized innovation only after useful implementation. If gains are negligible, ordinary improvement is the competing interpretation.
organization_specific_finding: Business-Model Disruption Judgment: Moderate, conditional over 12–24 months. Faster production could reduce billable drafting hours and pressure pricing, while advisory judgment remains the core differentiated service. Low is plausible if savings are small or redeployed into higher-value work; High would need evidence that routine summaries dominate client willingness to pay.

evidence.claim: The assignment requires separate general, application and organization findings and creative-destruction analysis.
evidence.notes: Basis for specialist scope, not external proof of firm outcomes.

evidence.claim: In an experiment involving 758 consultants, effects of GPT-4 assistance varied by task, with benefits within its capability frontier and worse correctness on a task outside it.
evidence.source_or_reference: E2: Dell’Acqua et al., Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier, Organization Science, https://doi.org/10.1287/orsc.2025.21838
evidence.notes: Supports practical capability and task-specific limits; does not establish the hypothetical firms’ economics or 2026 model performance.

evidence.claim: Organizational baseline and proposed use are specified in the case.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: E2 does not test this firm, current tools, client demand or business-model consequences.
Trust, domain expertise and accountable interpretation may preserve advisory differentiation even if drafting is cheaper.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in conditional classification; low confidence in realized commercial impact. No field deployment, demand or unit-economics evidence is supplied.
value_opportunity_implication: Could enable faster draft preparation and capacity for interpretation; may displace drafting time and weaken hourly value capture. Partners and clients may benefit; junior analysts may lose practice opportunities. Net benefit remains unmeasured.
risk_governance_implication: Both timing risks matter. In the six-month pilot, premature release of unverified summaries or unapproved client data use is the immediate concern. Over 12–24 months, failing to investigate effective drafting assistance could expose hourly work to price pressure. There is no competitor or revenue evidence to rank their monetary magnitude. Use approved inputs, consultant review and a reversible pilot; assess reviewed time and client pricing before expansion.
recommendation_management_implication: Compare reviewed pilot work with the current workflow, including total review time, errors and realized revenue per engagement. Preserve consultant responsibility and assess pricing before scaling; final adoption approval belongs to management and the adoption expert.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess after the six-month evaluation or a material workflow/pricing change.
Reclassify when practical deployment changes roles, channel or revenue logic.
Reassess exposure when client purchasing behavior, total reviewed cost or revenue concentration is measured.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request baseline task time, review cost, pricing and revenue mix.
Request client acceptance, error evidence and approved data-handling arrangements.
Do not certify legal compliance, forecast job loss or declare industry-wide disruption.
